The host expands on the theory that Charlie Kirk was killed by an explosive shaped charge hidden in his clip-on Rode wireless microphone. She credits Don Porter, a friend of Corey Comperatore, for the leads behind her previous Butler episode, and says the microphone theory was first put forward by an X user she names as Jon Bray. Using a mashup of Charlie Kirk's 2024 events (A-2668.1), she says he used a single handheld microphone until the fall 2024 You're Being Brainwashed tour, when a clipped wireless mic held by a magnetic clip was added (A-2668.2). She lists what she calls supporting evidence: bomb dogs were on scene but were not brought to where Charlie Kirk sat; contractors were called on a Sunday to pave over the scene by Monday, which a contractor says the governor and the FBI wanted (A-2669); a YouTuber's 20 g PETN test left a hole about the size of a .30-06 round (A-2670.1); and shards appear in photos of the transport SUV (A-2671.1), which Jon Bray says are ABS plastic from the microphone.

The host also revisits points she says undermine the case against Tyler Robinson and the conduct of the Turning Point USA team. These include five other sets of prints on the rifle, no gunshot residue test, Terryl Farnsworth removing the SD card from the camera behind Charlie Kirk's head, and Mikey McCoy and Blake Neff calling family rather than 911. She contrasts a Jack Hibbs interview with Frank Turek (A-2672.1) against Turek's account to Megyn Kelly that his FaceTime call stayed open until he reached the hotel (A-2672.2). She says Kash Patel had the hospital footage taken, and that no one at TPUSA has confirmed seeing the live stream TPUSA said it was sending to its office. She asks for tips about the October 10 explosion at Accurate Energetic Systems in Hickman County, Tennessee, which she says some believe could be where a device was assembled (A-2673.1).

In the second segment, the host recounts a public exchange on X with the FBI's account (A-2674). The exchange followed her post that the FBI called her FOIA request for Kash Patel's three-day pre-assassination travel itinerary too burdensome. The account replied that she had misquoted it and that calling the request "denied" was "a lie for clickbait." She also says a FOIA request for emails naming Erika Kirk after the White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting was called too burdensome, and she points to the Department of Justice's Epstein binders event as clickbait of its own.

The host then gives a health update on a veteran who travelled with her team to Russia (A-2675). She says he served 12 years, including in SEAL Team One, was repeatedly denied a VA appointment, and had a seizure the day after landing; a Russian hospital took him into surgery. In the comments (A-2676), she denies ever dismissing the exploding-mic theory and revisits Frank Turek's account of finding Charlie Kirk's necklace on his backpack. She argues that the necklace broke before Charlie Kirk reacted to the wound. She also restates that Connor Henderson interned in the Timpanogos emergency department and is a long-time friend of Zachariah Qureshi, whose father co-founded Built with a Henderson.

lines: - **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2673.1 (tip request, nothing shown). The host also refers without showing anything to Erika Kirk's Bari Weiss interview, the September 16 TPUSA Zoom call, Kash Patel's FOIA response letter (she says it was shown on the prior day's show) and the Epstein-binders tweet ("I don't know if you have my tweet"). A-2674.6 is logged at Medium because it is unclear whether the photo was put on screen.

- **DIA beats**: one real beat (44:47, tips@candaceowens.com for the Hickman County explosion, repeated as "More tips@candaceowens. com" in the same paragraph); it is logged as C-10019, A-2673.1 and M-12. At 01:03:56 the host thanks Evie for "a massive uh tip," which is about her hairstyle, not a DIA beat. No bounty and no CIA merch phrase aired, so M-14 is not used.

- **Name matching**: "Jon Bray" (03:00), "John Braden" (08:07) and "John Blake" (25:01, 26:45) are treated as one new person, N-681 Jon Bray, because the context (X user, mic theory, SUV photos) is the same. The correct spelling is unverified. "Terryl", "Taral" and "Terryl Farnsworth" are mapped to N-261. "Frank Turek" (25:46) is mapped to N-7 Frank Turek. "Zachariah Qureshi" and "Sam Qureshi" are mapped to N-410 Zachariah Qureshi; the host corrects herself to Zachariah on air. "Blake" at 30:41 is taken as Blake Neff. "The governor" in the contractor clip is presumably Spencer Cox, but he is not named, so he is not mentioned. "Ashley" in the control room (03:00, 01:03:02) is a staff member and is not minted.

- **Possible duplicate topic**: N-10844 reuses the staging title WHCD "Emotional Asset" Email Verification (episode 106). Other staging drafts use "White House Military Office Erika Kirk Amplification Email" for what may be the same email; the integrator may want to merge them.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "Rode"/"road mic"/"road bike" (the Rode wireless microphone), "PTN" (PETN), "ex-user" (X user), "Hampton Summit" (Hamptons) and "Built" (Built Inc.). Snippets keep "the.30-06" without a space, as the transcript has it.

- **Cross-episode links left out**: C-609 (episode 7, UVU repaved within about 48 hours) conflicts on timing with the contractor's Sunday account, but it is not clearly the same proposition, so it is not linked. C-1363 (SD card removal on law-enforcement instruction) may relate to C-9996, but the source of the instruction differs, so it is left unlinked.
- The host's opinion that Kash Patel's girlfriend runs the FBI rapid-response account ("my conspiracy theory of the week")
- The view that there is "more evidentiary support" for a rigged explosive than for Tyler Robinson
- The speculation that the charge was meant to hit Charlie Kirk's chest
- The view that the assassination is "Israel coded"
- The characterizations that the TPUSA team "look infinitely more suspicious" and had glowed at the memorial
- The speculation that the ER was cleared
- The view that the military would have been needed to build the device
- Rhetorical questions about why no one called 911
- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: the White House lawn turned into a UFC arena; Tyler Robinson's reported high IQ and 4.0 GPA; the host's ongoing Pale of Settlement book-club reading.
- **Sponsor reads** (Tax Network USA) and merch and book-club promotion are excluded.
